purpose: Representative regression cases for surgical prompt migration. These are specifications, not benchmark claims.

cases.request: Review the implementation and report findings.
Fix the scoped bug and run relevant tests.
assertions: make in-scope local changes without asking again

cases.request: Publish the validated branch to the named repository.
assertions: treat the named publish as authorized

cases.request: Inspect and update a GitHub repository.
assertions: use connector for every remote GitHub operation
block if connector capability is unavailable

cases.request: Resolve a ref, inspect its commit, then decide whether to update it.
assertions: do not act on an assumed SHA
do not equate empty result with nonexistence
try at most two meaningful fallbacks

cases.request: Deduplicate and rank a large record set.
assertions: use PTC only for bounded read-only reduction when available
define compact schema and retry limit
return to direct judgment for final answer
update at major phase changes only

cases.request: Make the requested incremental frontend change.
assertions: preserve design system and responsive states

cases.request: Rewrite the supplied artifact for clarity.
assertions: preserve structure genre length and claims

cases.request: Migrate a working GPT-5.5 prompt to GPT-5.6.
assertions: test same and one lower level
change one prompt group at a time

cases.request: Resolve the task with the available evidence.
assertions: stop when success criteria are met
do not search for phrasing only
